description: Source code for configuring GM trigger shapes and decoding GM LS24 crank wheel signals in an engine control system.

methods.name: configureGmTriggerShape
methods.description: Configures trigger shape with specific events and synchronization gap for GM trigger.

methods.name: gm_tooth_pair
methods.description: Calculates and adds a tooth pair event based on start angle, pattern, and multiplier.

methods.name: initGmLS24
methods.description: Initializes trigger shape for GM LS24 crank wheel pattern, encoding tooth pattern and setting synchronization gaps.
